programme.title: O Paraíso das Senhoras T3 - Ep. 101
programme.desc: Agnese culpa Elena pela briga entre Salvatore e Antonio, que rompe o noivado com a rapariga e vai trabalhar no clube com Giovanni.

programme.title: Segredos Mortais
programme.desc: O caso ilícito de uma jovem esposa de um militar termina em tragédia quando surgem suspeitas sobre o seu desaparecimento inesperado nas minas do Parque Nacional Joshua Tree.

programme.title: Quarto 309 (Tur) T2 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Kurtulus consegue tirar o colar da bolsa de Lale. Yildirim descobre o grande segredo de Onur. Onur vai comprar um presente para Duru e percebe que não sabe nada sobre a filha.

programme.title: O Homem Errado (Tur) T1 - Ep. 39
programme.desc: O La Laguna começa a dar problemas e Özgür fica tenso. Ezgi descobre que Özgür lhe vai fazer uma surpresa e pensa em casamento Tolga faz uma revelação sobre o Özgür a Serdar.

programme.title: ASLI entre herdeiros (Tur) T1 - Ep. 27
programme.desc: Tudo parece estar contra Asli e Burak. Ela teve de deixar o emprego, Volkan recrimina-o pela sua atitude, mas, no meio de todos os problemas, surge um aliado inesperado.

programme.title: O Fruto Proibido (Tur) T2 - Ep. 42
programme.desc: Os planos de Alihan caem por terra. Todos os traem, mas ele ainda tem alguns trunfos na mão. Serão suficientes para derrotar Halit?.

programme.title: O Fruto Proibido (Tur) T2 - Ep. 43
programme.desc: Yildiz quer sair e divertir-se, mas Halit impõe-lhe regras como se fosse pai dela. Quem terá de se adaptar à situação?.

programme.title: Amor Eterno T1 - Ep. 39
programme.desc: Kemal põe em marcha o seu plano para se apoderar das pens e Nihan desconfia dele. Emir está a tramar alguma coisa que envolve Kemal.

programme.title: Flores de Aço (1989)
programme.desc: Magnólias de aço é a história do salão de beleza de Truvy e do seu grupo de amigas, que vivem na mesma cidade,.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador T1 - Ep. 153
programme.desc: Sanem fabrica o perfume de que Can gostava, noutra tentativa de fazê-lo recordar. Entretanto, a agência tem uma apresentação muito importante para o seu futuro.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador T1 - Ep. 154
programme.desc: Leyla obtém uma posição melhor na agência, pelo seu grande esforço. Sanem estraga uma reunião muito importante e, por sua culpa, têm de encontrar alguém que se faça passar por Arthur Capello. Niaht diz a Emre que devem fazer algo para se livrarem de JJ.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador T1 - Ep. 155
programme.desc: Sanem fica com ciúmes ao conhecer a filha do Sr. Azim, porque percebe que é muito parecida com Can e têm muito em comum. JJ decide sair de casa de Mevkibe e ela fica muito triste com a sua partida.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador T1 - Ep. 156
programme.desc: JJ volta a viver com Muzaffer. Can agradece a Sanem pelo seu trabalho na agência e oferece-lhe uma flor. Can consulta um médico, preocupado com a sua perda de memória, já que não consegue recordar nada sobre a Sanem.

programme.title: Viola come il mare T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Viola colabora com Demir no caso de tentativa de homicídio, mas descobre que o dom da sinestesia não é infalível. Tamara encoraja Viola a pedir a ajuda de Demir na investigação sobre o seu pai, que desapareceu.

programme.title: 28 Dias
programme.desc: Gwen Cummings é uma escritora de sucesso de Nova Yorque, entregada a uma vida de discotecas, festas e ressacas. Tudo muda quando, após um vergonhoso acidente quando conduzia uma limusine depois do casamento da sua irmã, tem de escolher entre a prisão ou a reabilitação.

programme.title: Prometo Amar-te
programme.desc: Um acidente de automóvel coloca Paige em coma. Quando ela acorda e revela sofrer de total perda de memória, o seu marido Leo não tem outra alternativa senão empenhar-se para reconquistar o seu coração, pela segunda vez.

programme.title: Tudo o que Tínhamos
programme.desc: Este é um drama que narra a história de Ruthie Carmichael e da sua mãe Rita, para quem a vida nunca foi um mar de rosas. Relações abusivas, falta de trabalho e dinheiro obriga mãe e filha a fazerem-se à estrada na procura de uma vida melhor.

programme.title: O Fruto Proibido T3 - Ep. 33
programme.desc: A guerra pelo poder intensifica-se, quando velhas traições vêm à tona. À medida que Yildiz perde a confiança em Ender, novas alianças ameaçam mudar tudo.

programme.title: Pix E Leo
programme.desc: Vem conhecer a Pix, uma pequena raposa animada e brincalhona, e o seu melhor amigo Leo, um leão dorminhoco e curioso. Segue as suas aventuras engraçadas na selva, enquanto eles riem, brincam e aprendem sobre o mundo que os rodeia. Eles vão conhecer os seus vizinhos animais, explorar ambientes diferentes e descobrir que, seja qual for o conflito, poderão sempre contar um com o outro.

programme.title: Maya And Yaya
programme.desc: Bem-vindo ao mundo divertido e corajoso da Maya e Yaya, dois elefantes de plasticina com personalidades muito distintas. As duas amigas que se apoiam e incentivam mutuamente, enquanto ultrapassam os obstáculos e diferenças. Maya e Yaya resolvem as suas diferenças com bondade e empatia. Provavelmente, as amigas iniciam um desafio ou competição, mas no fim partilham sempre um abraço.

programme.title: Bem-Vindos À Ilha
programme.desc: Longe, numa pequena ilha viviam quatro amigos. Coco, o sábio coqueiro, Bucky o pedregulho curioso, Lily a pequena flor e Blossom, o feliz mamoeiro. Seria de imaginar que não aconteceria muita coisa numa ilha pequena e remota, mas a vida na ilha é cheia de alegria e emoção graças a visitantes ocasionais, como as simpáticas gaivotas que vêm limpar o oceano, a tartaruga que vem pôr ovos ou a abelha que vem à procura de pólen.

programme.title: A Pequena Lola Visita A Quinta

programme.title: Trilha Do Caracol
programme.desc: O Sr. Caracol é um amigável explorador que se aventura na área exterior para investigar o lado selvagem. Durante as suas jornadas, o Sr. Caracol conhece diferentes animais e realiza novas descobertas acerca do seu estilo de vida e o hábito de realizar perguntas engraçadas.

programme.title: Lale Ki Lolu
programme.desc: Lale e Lolu partem para várias aventuras num mundo mágico de encantar, criado especialmente para elas. Desde o antigo Egito até ao Extremo Oriente, as duas criaturas adoráveis comunicam através de sons, permitindo às crianças continuarem a história com a sua imaginação.

programme.title: Pix E Leo
programme.desc: Vem conhecer a Pix, uma pequena raposa animada e brincalhona, e o seu melhor amigo Leo, um leão dorminhoco e curioso. Segue as suas aventuras engraçadas na selva, enquanto eles riem, brincam e aprendem sobre o mundo que os rodeia. Eles vão conhecer os seus vizinhos animais, explorar ambientes diferentes e descobrir que, seja qual for o conflito, poderão sempre contar um com o outro.

programme.title: Maya And Yaya
programme.desc: Bem-vindo ao mundo divertido e corajoso da Maya e Yaya, dois elefantes de plasticina com personalidades muito distintas. As duas amigas que se apoiam e incentivam mutuamente, enquanto ultrapassam os obstáculos e diferenças. Maya e Yaya resolvem as suas diferenças com bondade e empatia. Provavelmente, as amigas iniciam um desafio ou competição, mas no fim partilham sempre um abraço.

programme.title: Agência De Detetives Da Zeina
programme.desc: Um objeto, tão familiar, do dia a dia chega à porta de Zeina esquecendo-se da sua utilidade. Ao procurarem a resposta, Zeina e o seu melhor amigo Roy inventam um novo uso hilariante para o objeto surpreendido. Enquanto todos se divertem imenso com a sua nova utilidade, é-lhes revelado o verdadeiro uso do objeto.

programme.title: A Bicicleta Do Mike
programme.desc: A oficina de bicicletas do Mike é um lugar onde todos vão quando têm um problema para resolver. Seja grande ou pequeno, o Mike está sempre lá para ajudar os seus amigos com as suas invenções únicas, peculiares e engraçadas, que colocam um sorriso no rosto de todos. A série coloca a frase “se não conseguires à primeira, volta a tentar outra vez (vezes sem conta)” sob outra perspectiva.

programme.title: Olha O Que Encontrei
programme.desc: Uma criança entra num quarto e descobre um objeto doméstico. A história desenrola no quarto assim como na imaginação do menino, onde cada objeto se transforma em algo divertido e surpreendente. Um sapato transforma-se num carro, um pedaço de papel num avião e muito mais! A série apresenta-nos a interação com pequenos objetos a par com a imaginação da criança, que pode transformar um objeto em algo maior do que a vida!.

programme.title: Lale Ki Lolu
programme.desc: Lale e Lolu partem para várias aventuras num mundo mágico de encantar, criado especialmente para elas. Desde o antigo Egito até ao Extremo Oriente, as duas criaturas adoráveis comunicam através de sons, permitindo às crianças continuarem a história com a sua imaginação.

programme.title: Pix E Leo
programme.desc: Vem conhecer a Pix, uma pequena raposa animada e brincalhona, e o seu melhor amigo Leo, um leão dorminhoco e curioso. Segue as suas aventuras engraçadas na selva, enquanto eles riem, brincam e aprendem sobre o mundo que os rodeia. Eles vão conhecer os seus vizinhos animais, explorar ambientes diferentes e descobrir que, seja qual for o conflito, poderão sempre contar um com o outro.

programme.title: Maya And Yaya
programme.desc: Bem-vindo ao mundo divertido e corajoso da Maya e Yaya, dois elefantes de plasticina com personalidades muito distintas. As duas amigas que se apoiam e incentivam mutuamente, enquanto ultrapassam os obstáculos e diferenças. Maya e Yaya resolvem as suas diferenças com bondade e empatia. Provavelmente, as amigas iniciam um desafio ou competição, mas no fim partilham sempre um abraço.

programme.title: Bem-Vindos À Ilha
programme.desc: Longe, numa pequena ilha viviam quatro amigos. Coco, o sábio coqueiro, Bucky o pedregulho curioso, Lily a pequena flor e Blossom, o feliz mamoeiro. Seria de imaginar que não aconteceria muita coisa numa ilha pequena e remota, mas a vida na ilha é cheia de alegria e emoção graças a visitantes ocasionais, como as simpáticas gaivotas que vêm limpar o oceano, a tartaruga que vem pôr ovos ou a abelha que vem à procura de pólen.

programme.title: Bem-Vindos À Ilha

programme.title: Olha O Que Encontrei
programme.desc: Uma criança entra num quarto e descobre um objeto doméstico. A história desenrola no quarto assim como na imaginação do menino, onde cada objeto se transforma em algo divertido e surpreendente. Um sapato transforma-se num carro, um pedaço de papel num avião e muito mais! A série apresenta-nos a interação com pequenos objetos a par com a imaginação da criança, que pode transformar um objeto em algo maior do que a vida!.

programme.title: Sports Scene
programme.desc: Sports Scene brings you closer to all the action from all corners of the world, with highlights from across Europe, North America and China's top sports leagues.

programme.title: Força Em Alerta 2
programme.desc: Casey Ryback parte de férias com a sobrinha num comboio do Colorado a Los Angeles, só que, logo no início da viagem, um grupo de terroristas invade o veiculo para usá-lo como quartel general na captura de um satélite altamente secreto e extraordinariamente destrutivo.

programme.title: Peppermint
programme.desc: Riley North acorda de um coma após o assassinato do seu marido e da sua filha num brutal ataque à sua família. Quando o sistema protege os assassinos da justiça, Riley transforma-se numa verdadeira guerrilheira urbana, aplicando de forma metódica a sua forma muito pessoal de justiça.

programme.title: Relação Perigosa
programme.desc: Num colégio feminino na Austrália, uma aluna apaixonada pelo professor de filosofia acusa-o falsamente de violação quando se sente rejeitada por ele.

programme.title: Yakuza
programme.desc: Harry Kilmer é um detetive norte-americano reformado que regressa ao Japão após décadas de ausência para tentar salvar a filha de um amigo, raptada pela organização criminosa nipónica cujos membros são conhecidos como Yakuza.

programme.title: Ensaio Final
programme.desc: Depois de sofrer um ataque cardíaco, um famoso ator com problemas com a bebida, decide embarcar numa última aventura, percorrendo o país de carro ao lado do filho que outrora depôs contra ele aquando do divórcio dos pais.

programme.title: Rosalie
programme.desc: Em 1870, Rosalie é uma jovem que esconde um segredo: ela tem barba, que oculta com receio de ser rejeitada pela sociedade. Quando Abel casa com ela, ainda desconhece esse facto, só que ela quer deixar de ocultar essa realidade e passar a ser vista e amada tal como realmente é.

programme.title: O Caminho Para A Verdade
programme.desc: Alison Miller é uma mulher com um passado turbulento, cujo pai está preso por homicídio e cujo irmão desparece e se torna o suspeito número um de um novo crime. Agora, só ela poderá provar a inocência do rapaz mas para isso terá de encontrá-lo antes das autoridades.

programme.title: Pequeno Grande Guerreiro
programme.desc: Um velho soldado raso e um jovem general de um estado rival são os únicos sobreviventes de uma batalha terrível. O primeiro decide então raptar o segundo e levá-lo numa longa jornada cheia de peripécias para recolher a recompensa que lhe é devida.

programme.title: True Justice: A Vingança é Minha
programme.desc: Depois da sua antiga equipa ter sido assassinada, o antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane recruta novos membros para formar um esquadrão implacável de combate ao crime, prometendo vingar a morte dos antigos companheiros.

programme.title: True Justice: Via de Sangue
programme.desc: Elijah Kane envolve-se numa nova missão governamental para tentar apanhar um mafioso envolvido em tráfico de pessoas e descobre uma conspiração mais alargada de venda de órgãos humanos.

programme.title: Mile 22
programme.desc: Uma pequena equipa de elite de oficiais americanos, parte de uma unidade operações especiais e secretas, tem por missão levar para fora da Indonésia um misterioso agente da polícia com informações sensíveis.

programme.title: Projeto 725
programme.desc: A filha do CEO de uma empresa de tecnologia é raptada por um grupo terrorista que pretende roubar o poderoso programa informático “Projeto 725” para causar estragos por todo o mundo. No meio do caos, só um destemido grupo de mercenários poderá evitar o pior…

programme.title: Machete Mata
programme.desc: O governo dos EUA recruta Machete para uma missão no México para deter um revolucionário psicopata que quer lançar um míssil nuclear em Washington.

programme.title: Os Vizinhos Lá De Cima
programme.desc: Xavier e Sophie são casados há 25 anos mas a sua relação sofre um forte abalo quando convidam para jantar o jovem casal que mora no andar de cima, que fará com que eles se apercebam da monotonia da sua vida diária e se vejam desafiados por uma proposta ligeiramente… indecente!

programme.title: Guardiãs Do Túmulo
programme.desc: Numa missão de salvamento do irmão, Jia descobre o túmulo subterrâneo de um antigo imperador chinês, que viveu uma vida estranhamente longa 200 anos antes de Cristo, só que rapidamente percebe que desenterrou também um segredo que devia ter ficado para sempre soterrado.

programme.title: The Contractor: Mercenário
programme.desc: Após ser dispensado das Forças Especiais do Exército e perder a pensão e o seguro de saúde, James Harper, endividado e com a família para sustentar, assina contrato com a uma equipa militar privada. Só que quando primeira missão corre mal, ele torna-se um alvo a abater.

programme.title: The Loveless
programme.desc: Numa pequena cidade do sul dos EUA, um gangue de motoqueiros envolve-se em problemas enquanto se dirige para as corridas em Daytona.

programme.title: Órfã: A Origem
programme.desc: Depois de planear uma brilhante fuga de um hospital psiquiátrico na Estónia, Esther viaja até aos EUA passando-se pela filha desaparecida de uma família milionária. No entanto, após uma inesperada reviravolta, a mãe começa a desconfiar da “criança” assassina, e tudo faz para proteger a sua família.

programme.title: Como Matar E Ganhar
programme.desc: Após um acidente de viação fatal, Michel foge do local e quando lá regressa com a mulher para tentar encobrir o incidente e esconder as vítimas, encontra dois milhões de euros num saco, o que dá origem a uma série de acontecimentos caóticos.

programme.title: Viagem À Juventude
programme.desc: Brian aceitar levar o seu sogro deprimido de 80 anos até Oregon, onde a eutanásia é legal, só que ao longo do caminho vai ajudá-lo a redescobrir uma razão para viver.

programme.title: Romance And Cigarros
programme.desc: Nick é um metalúrgico de Nova Iorque casado com Kitty mas que mantém um caso em segredo a escaldante Tula. Quando a traição é descoberta, ele terá de encontrar rapidamente uma forma de reconquistar a família, correndo o risco de chegar demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Praxx Fim De Semana
programme.desc: Inverno, sexta-feira. Um grupo de jovens universitários parte para um fim de semana em São João da Cruz, para celebrar a sua ascensão na prestigiada Associação da Vida Académica. A diversão dos jovens acaba por dar lugar ao terror quando à noite, na Praia da Cruz, um ritual de praxe é levado ao limite.

programme.title: True Justice: Ações Violentas
programme.desc: Enquanto investiga o desaparecimento de uma carrinha de segurança que transportava 20 milhões de dólares, o antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane vai enfrentar um perigoso mafioso, uma organização misteriosa chamada Quicksilver e uma figura do passado que ele e a CIA julgavam morta.

programme.title: True Justice: Anjo da Morte
programme.desc: O antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane enfrenta terroristas que tentam traficar bombas nucleares em malas de viagem, desconfiando que é o seu maior inimigo quem está a tentar apanhá-las.

programme.title: Covil De Ladrões
programme.desc: A unidade de elite de combate ao crime de Los Angeles, que nem sempre joga pelas regras, entra em confronto com o gangue de assalto a bancos mais bem sucedido da cidade. Quando os fora-da-lei decidem assaltar a Reserva Federal, qual dos dois se revelará o mais implacável?

programme.title: O Coletivo
programme.desc: Um jovem recruta para uma misteriosa agência de assassinos torna-se um pária na sua primeira missão, rastreando um perigoso grupo de traficantes de pessoas.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: O arqueólogo Daniel Jackson descobre como fazer funcionar um portal estelar descoberto debaixo de uma pirâmide. O coronel Jonathan ´Jack´ O´Neil recebe a missão de acompanhar Jackson e uma pequena equipa de soldados americanos através do stargate para explorar a galáxia desconhecida do outro lado.

programme.title: Os Perdedores
programme.desc: Um grupo de agentes especiais da CIA é traído pelos seus superiores e abandonado à morte certa. Contra todas as expectativas, os operacionais voltam a juntar-se para se vingarem de quem os deixou ficar para trás.

programme.title: Safe - O Intocável
programme.desc: Mei é uma jovem de memória prodigiosa que tem na cabeça um código numérico que a leva a ser perseguia pelas tríades chinesas, a máfia russa e polícias corruptos de Nova Iorque. Em seu auxílio surge um ex-polícia caído em desgraça que não se vai deter perante nada para a proteger..

programme.title: O Capanga: Vingança
programme.desc: Pat Tate lança-se numa cruzada para vingar a morte violenta do seu amigo durante um assalto, mergulhando no lado negro do Soho nos anos 90.

programme.title: Coriolano
programme.desc: Caius Martius ´Coriolano´, um temido general romano, está em conflito com a cidade de Roma e com os seus concidadãos, e alia-se ao seu jurado inimigo Tullus Aufidius para se vingar.

programme.title: Gala from Berlin 1998 - Songs of Love and Desire
programme.desc: Featuring W. A. Mozart and Giuseppe Verdi, love is the theme of this 1998 New Year's Eve concert. Maestro Claudio Abbado selected two of the best Mozart interpreters, Christine Schäfer and Simon Keenlyside, for this traditionally meaningful event.

programme.title: Israel Philharmonic Orchestra: Coming Home
programme.desc: On December 24, 2011, one of the world’s most renowned classical orchestras, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra, celebrated the 75th anniversary of its founding. The film portrays the orchestra and its eventful history against the backdrop of Israel and the holocaust.

programme.title: Verdi - La traviata
programme.desc: This production of Giuseppe Verdi's popular opera La Traviata was performed outdoors at the St. Margarethen Festival in 2008 by the Slovak Philharmonic Orchestra under the direction of Ernst Märzendorfer. Soloists Kristiane Kaiser, Magdalena Anna Hofmann, and Stefanie Kopinits perform in a striking physical setting against the backdrop of the Austrian mountains.

programme.title: Liszt/Wagner - Tannhäuser Overture S.442
programme.desc: Mengjie Han (*1989) performs Franz Liszt’s transcription of Richard Wagner’s Tannhäuser Overture, S.442, during the quarter finals of the Liszt Piano Competition 2014. Han studied at the Royal Conservatory of The Hague with Marlies van Gent, and with Jan Wijn at the Conservatory of Amsterdam.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven's Octet and Dvorák's Serenade
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is an orchestra based in Berlin, Germany and is ranked as one of the best orchestras in the world. In 1990, orchestra members played beautiful chamber music, such as Ludwig van Beethoven's Octet in E-flat major and Antonin Dvorák's Serenade in D minor. Even though both compositions were written for wind instruments, Beethoven reworked and expanded his String Quartet No. 1 for this composition.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Symphony in Three Movements
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berliner Philharmonic during the 2008 edition of the Europakonzert, held in the renowned hall of the Tchaikovsky Conservatory in Moscow. The first edition of the Europakonzert was in 1991, and since then, the founding of the Berlin Philharmonic on May 1st in 1882 is annually celebrated with a concert in a European city of cultural significance.

programme.title: Schubert - Winterreise
programme.desc: Baritone Samuel Hasselhorn and pianist Daniel Heide perform Franz Schubert’s song cycle Winterreise (‘Winter’s journey’). The 30-year-old Schubert wrote this masterpiece in 1827, just a year before his death. Like Schubert’s earlier song cycle Die schöne Müllerin (1823), Winterreise is a setting of the poetry of Wilhelm Müller (1794-1827).

programme.title: Christmas Concert
programme.desc: On 18 December 2017, the Valerius Ensemble played a Christmas concert in Concordia, Enschede. The ensemble consists of Robert Windak (violin), Annemarie van Vliegen (violin), Eva Šušliková (viola) and Réne Geesing (cello). The program consists of “Das neugeborne Kindelein” from Bachs Cantata BWV 122, the Largo from Vivaldi’s Winter, the Allegro from Mozart’s Divertimento in D (KV.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret?

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Josquin’s motets
programme.desc: In 15th-century polyphony suffering is, after love, possibly the most important theme. As in the Flemish Primitives’ paintings, the tears flow copiously in the oeuvre of composers such as Josquin Desprez. With this selection of Josquin’s finest dark timbres (Miserere mei, De profundis, Absalon fili mi), Cappella Amsterdam guarantees us a breathtaking programme with a palette of muted colours.

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: PIAM - Final: Beethoven, Chopin and Prokofiev
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Night on Bald Mountain
programme.desc: Young Euro Classic is the world’s most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development. For 17 days every summer, orchestras from all over the world perform at Berlin’s Konzerthaus, on Gendarmenmarkt. This performance features some highlights of the Young Euro Classic edition of 2016.

programme.title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström’ (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story.

programme.title: Sibelius - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: In 2013, the Finnish conductor Hannu Lintu was appointed principal conductor of the Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra. Lintu studied piano and cello at the Sibelius Academy and the Turku conservatorium in Sweden’s southeast. He started conducting at the Sibelius Academy.

programme.title: Handel at Chambord Castle
programme.desc: This 2016 concert at Chambord Castle in France under the direction of Hervé Niquet features 70 musicians that gave a spectacular performance of Handel‘s Water Music and Music for the Royal Fireworks. In between Le Concert Spirituel also plays Concerto Grosso’s No. 4 and No. 5 also by Georg Friedrich Handel.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Albéniz - Iberia Book 1 And 2
programme.desc: Star pianist Daniel Barenboim performs the first and second books of Isaac Albéniz’s piano suite Iberia. Composed between 1905 and 1908, Iberia is in four books of three pieces each. This masterpiece paints twelve musical portraits of Spanish regions, traditions, and atmospheres. This performance was recorded at the Teatro Colón in Buenos Aires, Argentina, on August 19, 2000.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2007 - Berlin
programme.desc: The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 1, Op. 23
programme.desc: Roberto Giordano performs Chopin's Ballade No. 1, Op. 23. The sketches of the work date back to 1831 during Chopin's eight-month stay in Vienna. The first ballade was completed in 1835 after the composer moved to Paris.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Von Weber - Der Freischütz
programme.desc: This unique production of Carl Maria von Weber’s ‘Der Freischütz’ was created to celebrate both the piece’s 200th premiere anniversary at Konzerthaus Berlin and the 200th anniversary of the famed concert hall itself.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 6
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Chamber Symphony Op. 110a
programme.desc: The Casco Phil, The Chamber Music Orchestra of Belgium, conducted by Benjamin Haemhouts, performs Shostakovich’s Chamber Symphony, Op. 110a. The work is a transcription by Rudolf Barshai of Shostakovich’s String Quartet No. 8, which was composed in only three days (July 12 to 14 1960). The work draws from Shostakovich’s pieces, like the Symphonies No. 1 and 5, and a Jewish theme from Piano Trio No. 2.

programme.title: Triple Concerto, Op. 56 And Symphonie Fantastique
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven’s Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. Beethoven's Concerto for Violin, Cello, and Piano in C major, commonly known as the Triple Concerto, was composed from 1803 to 1804.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2, 'Resurrection'
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, ‘Resurrection’. Soprano Christiane Karg and alto Claudia Huckle are the soloists. Written between 1888 and 1894, this five-movement symphony is scored for a large orchestra, chorus, and soprano and alto soloists.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Beethoven No. 5
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Ludwig van Beethoven’s ‘Symphony No. 5’ is discussed.

programme.title: Boulez conducts Mahler's Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Pierre Boulez conducts the orchestra and choirs of the Berlin State Opera and the orchestra of the Staatskapelle Berlin in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2. This concert is part of a series of events celebrating the French conductor and composer's 80th birthday. With his uncompromising approach to the score, Boulez's Mahler readings have long fascinated critics and audiences alike.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 12
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 12, K 414
programme.desc: Vladimir Ashkenazy performs as a soloist and conductor in Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 12, K 414. He is accompanied by the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra at the Hampton Court Palace, London.

programme.title: Rota - The Godfather Suite
programme.desc: This exclusive live concert production presents a unique selection of movie classics - from Sergio Leone’s iconic Spaghetti Westerns to modern mafia masterpieces by Francis Ford Coppola and the cult movies of Tarantino. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir are conducted by Sarah Hicks in this premiere performance of authentic soundtracks by composer legends Ennio Morricone, Nino Rota, Sonny Bono and Bernard Herrmann.

programme.title: Baroque choral music by Bach, Schütz et al.
programme.desc: Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig’s St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz’s collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach.

programme.title: Strauss - Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Violinist Daniel Rowland, violist Rachel Roberts, cellist Julian Arp, and pianist Diana Ketler perform Richard Strauss’s Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13, as part of the Stiftfestival 2016 in the Dutch village of Weerselo. In his early years, Strauss tried to compose different types of chamber music works, including a piano quartet.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes at the Zurich Opera House
programme.desc: The Zurich Opera House is one of the most renowned in Europe. Fifteen premieres are staged here every year - a significant achievement, when one considers just how much work goes into each individual production.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Works for cello and fortepiano by Beethoven
programme.desc: Every year in late August, the renowned Early Music Festival takes place in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is the world's largest festival focused on early music, attracting an audience of over 70 thousand visitors. Due to the corona pandemic, the 2020 edition of the festival took place in an alternative form, offering an alternative program that included live concerts as well as daily livestreams of concerts and archive recordings.

programme.title: Soulscapes
programme.desc: In retrospect, the version for solo dance of Stravinsky’s Sacre du printemps can be interpreted as a bleak, oppressive dance about his own life. The ballet is one of the late works by Uwe Scholz, one of the most important choreographers of the twentieth century. During his short life, this wunderkind created over 100 ballets, including major stage successes such as Die Schöpfung, Die Grosse Messe and Bruckner 8.

programme.title: Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire.

programme.title: Bach – Italian Concerto And Chaconne (arr. Busoni)
programme.desc: Italian classical pianist Costanza Principe (1993) started playing the piano at age 6, making her public debut at age 7. Before long she would be performing as a soloist with numerous prestigious orchestras in Italy, the UK, France, and South America.

programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 94, Hob. I:94
programme.desc: Joseph Haydn (1732-1809): Symphony No. 94 in G major 'Surprise'. Berliner Philharmoniker; conductor: Mariss Jansons. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991. The musicians commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra's founding on May 1st, 1882, playing in different European cities. This concert was recorded in the church 'Hagia Eirene' in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Tales of Two Cities: Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. Its musical director is Jeanne Lamon. Together with the Trio Arabica they celebrate the music and culture in the eighteenth century.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 3
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major, K. 216. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Swan Lake (2015)
programme.desc: The Imperial Ice Stars are an ensemble of 24 world class skaters, holding more than 300 competition medals between them. Praised by critics and audiences alike, they never fail to enchant with creative and powerful story-telling, sumptuous sets, spectacular special effects and opulent costumes.

programme.title: Rina Sala Gallo Piano Competition 2022 - Finalists
programme.desc: The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. Founded in 1947 by Monza-born pianist Rina Sala Gallo and Brescia-born pianist Arturo Benedetti Michelangeli, the competition is one of Monza’s most prestigious cultural events today.

programme.title: Le Grand Orgue in Concert
programme.desc: Current holder of “Great Organ of the Notre Dame,” Olivier Latry began his musical career when he enrolled in Gaston Litaize’s organ class at the Academy of Saint-Maur at the age of 16. In 1985, at 23 years of age, Latry was awarded the post of one of four “titulaires des grands orgues” of Notre Dame, Paris.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. Originally commissioned as a ballet for the legendary dancer Martha Graham, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring (1944) has since become an American classic. While first scored for a thirteen-piece ensemble, Copland later arranged the work for a full orchestra.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - The Nutcracker
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's The Nutcracker is one of the best known and most beloved pieces from the composer. The music has inspired many choreographers to the tell the colourful Christmas fairy-tale of E. T. A. Hoffmann and Alexandre Dumas senior in the language of dance. Ben Stevenson is to this day considered one of the most important influencers of the American ballet art.

programme.title: Beethoven - Triple Concerto, Op. 56
programme.desc: American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 performed by three female soloists: Olga Kern (piano), Baibe Skride (violin) and Sol Gabetta (cello).

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Sonata No. 3, Op. 108
programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas by Johannes Brahms. Leonidas Kavakos rose to fame in 1985, when he became the youngest musician to ever win the first price of the prestigious Sibelius Competition.

programme.title: Schubert - Symphony No. 8 in B minor, D. 759
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance Les Dissonances perform Franz Schubert’s Symphony No. 8 in B minor, D. 759, also known as the ‘Unfinished Symphony’.

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 7, Op. 70
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Antonín Dvorák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. The work was completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvorák’s broader oeuvre.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2000 from Berlin
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev (piano), Karita Mattila (soprano), Violeta Urmana (alto), Thomas Moser (tenor), Eike Wilm Schulte (bass), Swedish Radio Choir, Eric Ericson Chamber Choir, Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, conductor: Claudio Abbado. Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Piano Concerto No. 2 in B flat major, Op. 19 - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991.

programme.title: Summertime at the Domaine Forget
programme.desc: The documentary Summertime at the Domaine Forget introduces internationally renowned treasure: Domaine Forget festival in Saint-Irénée, Québec. Domaine Forget is one of Canada's leading music academies and hosts this annual festival to promote music and dance.

programme.title: Donizetti - L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza conducts the Orchestra Gli Originali and the Coro Donizetti Opera in a performance of Geatano Donizetti’s comic opera L’elisir d’amore (‘The Elixer of Love’, 1832). L’elisir d’amore is perhaps the most famous work in Donizetti’s extensive repertoire. It tells the story of the poor peasant Nemorino who is in love with the beautiful landowner Adina.

programme.title: Chapa E Pintura T7 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Um C10 de 67 abandonado, que está parado há anos, foi vendido a um cliente. Este quer alguns retoques novos, mas uma inspeção mais minuciosa revela que é preciso mais trabalho.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T11 - Ep. 12

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T9 - Ep. 6

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T10 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Mike faz um ótimo negócio com um velho Aston Martin DB7. Conseguirá ele e Edd devolver esta obra de arte britânica à sua antiga glória e vendê-lo por bom dinheiro?

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T10 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Mike consegue um desejado Mk1 por 4,500 libras num leilão online. Irão as alterações e os melhoramentos de Edd dar uma nova vida a este clássico dos anos 70?

programme.title: Hoffman Family Gold T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Hunter enfrenta a tundra ártica quando ouve falar do lendário ouro em lagos distantes. De novo no acampamento, Andy trabalha para transformar a mina de ouro numa grande recompensa.

programme.title: Hoffman Family Gold T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Após resultados dececionantes com um antigo leito do rio, a equipa de Todd concentra-se em encontrar uma mina de ouro especial. O dono de uma mina leva Randy a um ponto de rutura.

programme.title: A Minha Família Vive No Alasca T7 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Os irmãos Brown enfrentam problemas no barco enquanto correm para cumprir um prazo. Bam esforça-se para salvar o dinheiro do rancho aprendendo com um agricultor de feno local.

programme.title: A Minha Família Vive No Alasca T7 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Os Brown devem navegar pelo traiçoeiro canal Narrows Wrangell, rumo à famosa Mosman Island. Porém, mares tempestuosos ameaçam a sua viagem.

programme.title: Pesca Radical T21 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Após uma fuga de químicos forçar Jake a sair do navio, Keith corre a ajudar a equipa e salvá-lo. Mandy dirige a primeira época real sozinha.

programme.title: Pesca Radical T21 - Ep. 3

programme.title: Pesca Radical T21 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Um ferimento de faca no convés deixa Sig em apuros. Um tripulante sai e as tensões explodem em Confidence. O acelerador de Keith falha no mar revolto.

programme.title: Pesca Radical T21 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: A 400 milhas a oeste de terras tradicionais, Keith e Monte entram em conflito. Rick e Bob enfrentam um tanque vazio e põem em risco a embarcação.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T9 - Ep. 7

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T9 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Saiba como espadas, barcos, relógios e fusíveis são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T9 - Ep. 11

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T9 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Descubra como coisas como bacon, máquinas de neve e carros de luxo são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T9 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: À medida que objetos do quotidiano são vistos à lupa, saiba como transmissões, pratas em miniatura, cestos de balões de ar quente e os dardos são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T13 - Ep. 8

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é feita a comida crua para cães? Ou as réplicas de luzes da polícia?

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: A equipa de artesãos transforma um conjunto de gavetas desgastadas. Depois, revitalizam um banco vitoriano e um lustre dos anos 60 que testemunhou o casamento de um dos Beatles.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Os artesãos ressuscitam um raro e valioso divertimento de feira. Depois, dão vida a um banco de jardim vitoriano e a uma mala de cavalheiro centenária.

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters T2 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Chase Morrill e a equipa renovam a cabana de uma família perto do Caminho dos Apalaches, mas o local remoto, o prazo e o orçamento são problemáticos.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 66
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 104
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 48
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Final Step Live @ Il Magazzino: Three Sails
programme.desc: From the polyglot border region of Ticino in Switzerland – well-known for its beautiful Lake Maggiore and the International Film Festival in Locarno – comes ‘Final Step’, guitarist Matteo Finali’s seven-piece band. 'Live @ Il Magazzino' is the band’s third album since its formation in 2003. The diverse musical backgrounds of the various band members shine through on the album: it is a fusion of jazz, rock, funk, blues and ethnic music.

programme.title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital’s central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano’s “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Philippe Lemm Trio
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Trevor Richards
programme.desc: English drummer Trevor Richards (1945) is a passionate advocate for traditional jazz. After moving to New Orleans at 21 to master the city's unique drumming styles, he has consistently created opportunities to perform with the genre's elder statesmen.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck Quartet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. The Dave Brubeck Quartet gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1982.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: A Trace of Grace
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Street Life
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: November Music: R. Frerichs/H. Alizadeh/Cello8ctet
programme.desc: The November Music festival in ‘s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands is the ultimate event for experiencing a broad range of music. It features a wonderful variety of contemporary and experimental pop, sound art, non-Western music, jazz and free improvisation.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong: Live in Australia
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Arturo Sandoval - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, Cuban trumpeter Arturo Sandoval brought his band with him to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble.

programme.title: November Music: Jon Balke Siwan
programme.desc: Since 1993, the November Music Festival has been held every year at various locations in the Dutch city of 's-Hertogenbosch. Highlighting a variety of contemporary musical styles and contemporary composers, November Music is today one of the most important festivals dedicated to contemporary music in the Netherlands.

programme.title: Marcus Miller: Thoughts on Miles
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited’ tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Naima
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Hijaz
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the multi-ethnic ensemble Hijaz.

programme.title: Crossroads: From Blues to Bossa
programme.desc: A two-part documentary, moderated by Dee Dee Bridgewater. Part 1: From Blues to Bossa On the search for the roots and origins of Jazz, we journey into the European and African music traditions and discover the cultural heritages of Jazz from Rio to New Orleans.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: World-renowned American blues singer and guitarist Magic Slim performed an electrifying set at the French festival Jazz à Vienne 2012. With bandmates John McDonald (guitar And vocals), Andre Howard (bass), and Brian Jones (drums), the blues giant played a string of classic Chicago blues hits. Ever energetic, the veritable blues veteran put on a dynamic show for an enthusiastic audience in the atmospheric ancient Roman theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: 29th Street Saxophone Quartet: Estival 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Session: From Rossini to Piazzolla
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Dilemma
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre.

programme.title: Jackie Davis in concert in Brussels
programme.desc: American soul jazz singer and organist Jackie Davis (1920-1999) contributed greatly to the popularity of the Hammond B3 organ in jazz, preceding even the great Jimmy Smith. Seen here during an intimate solo performance in Brussels in 1967, we get to enjoy Davis’ every musical twist and lyrical turn.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jozy
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Mike Stern And Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat And Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis’ comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation.

programme.title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’.

programme.title: Tania Maria Trio - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins live in Belgium, 1962
programme.desc: A jazz festival named after the inventor of the instrument most associated with the genre, Adolphe Sax, would be incomplete without the man who laid the groundwork for how the instrument is played today. This must have been the reasoning of the organizers of the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, when they invited tenor saxophone giant Coleman Hawkins to perform there in June 1962.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Winter 1980: Maynard Ferguson Big Band in Brussels
programme.desc: The Brussels Jazz Club was filled to the brim with both musicians and audience members when the Maynard Ferguson Big Band performed there during their Winter Tour of 1980. From the first notes of the cover of Weather Report’s “Birdland” that opens the performance to the final notes of “Gonna Fly Now” that closes it, Ferguson gives his young sidemen ample time to shine.

programme.title: Paï
programme.desc: Recorded in 1971 in Paris, France, Brazilian, classically trained bossa nova guitarist Baden Powell and his quartet play Pai, Lotus (written by Baden Powell), Tristeza (by Haroldo Lobo/Niltinho), Round Midnight (by Thelonious Monk), Nega do cabelo duro (by David Nasser/Rubens Soares), and Aos pes da cruz (by Zé da Zilda/Marino Pinto).

programme.title: Weird Fishes
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. One of them is Dutch singer, pianist, composer and bandleader Ruben Hein. Widely praised for his warm and characteristic voice and his offbeat piano playing, Ruben Hein is the artistic director and conductor of the National Youth Jazz Orchestra (NJJO).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again
programme.desc: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again - the title says is all… After an automobile accident and 15 years of revalidation, he is back! Together with his musical pals Edwin Corzilius (double bass) and Frits Landesbergen (drums), pianist and composer Lex Jasper celebrates his return to jazz club The Duke in the Dutch village of Nistelrode.

programme.title: Teus Nobel live at the Bimhuis Amsterdam
programme.desc: Teus Nobel is a Dutch trumpet and flugelhorn player. As a little boy, he was inspired by ‘power’ trumpeters such as Maynard Ferguson and Bill Chase. While studying at the conservatory, he played both as jazz player and as a commercial session musician at musicals. After his time at the conservatory, he started playing in the Royal Netherlands Air Force Orchestra, playing march music influenced by pop and jazz.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sammy Price and his All Star Orchestra
programme.desc: Texan pianist Sammy Price (1908-1992) played everything from blues and boogie-woogie to swing and jump-blues. Starting in Dallas as a singer and dancer in Alphonso Trent’s orchestra, he went to Kansas to form the Texas Bluesicians. At the end of the 1930s, and as a house pianist for the Decca label, he backed many stars, including Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Trixie Smith.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: John Scofield - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: The last chieftain
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, Calypso
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Bill Evans - Maison de la Radio
programme.desc: Bill Evans is considered one of the greatest jazz pianists all time and is known for interpreting the jazz repertoire using impressionistic harmonies. In 1958, Evans first played in Miles Davis’s sextet recording the modal jazz album “Kind of Blue”, which is now considered one of the best jazz albums of all time. After leaving the ensemble, Evans formed several trios.

programme.title: Art Blakey Live in 1965
programme.desc: Art Blakey: Live in '65 features a very impressive lineup from jazz history: Art Blakey (drums), Jaki Byard (piano), Reggie Workman (bass), Nathan Davis (sax), and the legendary trumpet player, Freddie Hubbard. For a fall tour of Europe, Blakey assembled The New Jazzmen, a short-lived quintet that performed this legendary concert at La Mutualité in Paris on November 3, 1965.

programme.title: On The Road With Duke Ellington: II
programme.desc: In May 2014, the Conservatory of Amsterdam hosted a unique conference about one of the greatest jazz composers of the 20th century: Duke Ellington. Musicologists and musicians with a special bond with Ellington and his music spoke about his life and music. Among them were David Schiff, author of ‘The Ellington Century’, and Harvey Cohen, author of ‘Duke Ellington’s America’.

programme.title: Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: STUFF. live at BIRD Rotterdam
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: The Flying Pickets - Don't Turn Around
programme.desc: The Flying Pickets are a British vocal group that was formed in 1982, transferring the art of a cappella to the pop music scene. These five gentlemen scored a number one hit in 1983 in the UK Singles Chart with their version of 'Only You'. Performing live in Stuttgart, vocalists Hereward Kaye, Gary Howard, Michael Henry, Nick Godfrey and Ricky Payne have many surprises in store for their appreciative audience.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Zyryab
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Guillaume Perret
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023 interview
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Crying Time
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Aretha Franklin: A trip in Paris
programme.desc: Live Recording at the Palais Des Sports from 1977. Aretha Franklin performs songs like ‘Respect’, ‘You make me feel like a natural woman’, ‘La vie en Rose’ and ‘Singing in the Rain’.

programme.title: Ramón Valle And Reinier Baas - Music Meeting 2020
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. Disrupted by COVID-19, the festival’s 2020 edition had to adapt to new challenges.

programme.title: Under the Surface - Live at Bimhuis 2018
programme.desc: Under the Surface is an improvisational jazz band formed by drummer Joost Lijbaart, vocalist Sanne Rambags, and guitarist Bram Stadhouders. Sanne Rambags, the youngest artist of the trio, is one of the few vocalists of her generation who able to improvise effortlessly, be it by using her voice as an instrument blending with the sounds of the band, or by performing her own poetry.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Harmen Fraanje
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: November Music
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Tigran Hamasyan And Mathias Eick - November Music
programme.desc: November Music, a Dutch music festival in ’s-Hertogenbosch, showcases today's prominent composers. It programs top-notch ensembles, jazz and world music pioneers, interdisciplinary concerts, and sound art. In 2019, Tigran Hamasyan and Mathias Eick played a duo performance here. Armenian pianist Hamasyan has claimed a category of his own in contemporary jazz. Norwegian trumpeter Mathias Eick is an undisputed master of his instrument.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: TorTube: Robin Nolan Trio - Swing de Paris
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: Ray Charles - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 22
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features the IBF Welterweight title bout, Jan Zaveck, aka 'Mr. Sympathicus', (31-1, 18 KOs) vs. Andre Berto (27-1, 21 KOs) from Beau Rivage Resort and Casino in Biloxi, Mississippi, USA, on September 3, 2011.

programme.title: XMA T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In this episode, we learn about how the use of motion animation technology can help martial artists learn more efficient ways to put extra power behind their punches and kicks.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is 'Sugar' Shane Mosley facing Ricardo Mayorga in a light middleweight title fight, the first of two bouts between the two, that features an exciting last-minute finish. Also on the card, action from former champs Juan Manuel Marquez and Juan Diaz.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T31 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 5, from Ryogoku Kokugikan. in Tokyo, Japan, features Takayasu, Takakeisho, Mitakeumi and Terunofuji.

programme.title: Macho: The Hector Camacho Story T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: This series takes a hard-hitting look at the rise, fall and untimely death of one of boxing's most colorful champions.
